pl_full_translation: Dopuszczeni, Panie, do świętego stołu, zaczerpnęliśmy z radością wody ze źródeł Zbawiciela; niech Jego Krew stanie się dla nas, prosimy, źródłem wody tryskającej ku życiu wiecznemu. Który z Tobą żyje i króluje w jedności Ducha Świętego, Bóg, na wieki wieków.
en_full_translation: Admitted to the sacred banquet, O Lord, we have drawn water in joy from the Savior’s fountains; may His Blood, we beseech You, become for us a fountain of water springing up to everlasting life. He lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

en_groups.gloss: of water springing up to everlasting life

mr_witness.independence_basis: The directly viewed Benziger proper page supplies the 23-word body and abbreviated cue. The same edition’s RG 115 c supplies the separately declared full conclusion; ritual response boundaries have their own source use. This is an explicit same-edition composite, not a literal full proper-page transcription.

locator.section: RG 115 c: conclusion addressed to the Father with mention of the Son near the end; complete Qui tecum formula through Amen

new_conclusion_use.claim: RG 115 c supplies the full conclusion Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate Spiritus Sancti, Deus, per omnia saecula saeculorum. Amen. This use supports the separately declared expansion of the proper page’s Qui tecum cue, not a claim that the proper page prints the full formula or the selected house accents.

apparatus.note: Adjudicated accidental and house-orthography variants. The explicitly bounded Benziger proper-body/RG 115 c composite and pinned digital expansion agree on the substantive text; neither proper-page cue is a claim that p. 583 prints the complete ending.

adjudicated.ruling: The controlling Benziger proper page prints eius; the pinned digital source prints ejus. The selected i-form follows the house rule in ORTHOGRAPHY.md. This is an orthographic difference, not a different pronoun.
Benziger RG 115 c, p. xviii, prints the comma after Spiritus Sancti in the expanded conclusion; pinned Ordo/Prayers.txt line 120 omits it. The proper page p. 583 does not print these expanded words.
Benziger RG 115 c, p. xviii, prints the comma after Deus in the expanded conclusion; pinned Ordo/Prayers.txt line 120 omits it. The proper page p. 583 does not print these expanded words.

before_frozen_prose: Admitted to the sacred banquet, O Lord, we have drawn water in joy from the Savior’s fountain; may His Blood, we beseech You, become for us a fountain of water springing up unto life everlasting, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
